availableCommands.name: debug
availableCommands.description: Debug your current Claude Code session by reading the session debug log. (bundled)

availableCommands.name: backend-patterns
availableCommands.description: Use when writing or reviewing server-side code — REST endpoints, Express or Next.js API routes, database queries and schema, auth middleware, caching, rate limiting, background jobs, or structured logging. Covers request validation, error envelopes, pagination, and the repository pattern. (user)

availableCommands.name: coding-standards
availableCommands.description: Use when writing new TypeScript or JavaScript modules, reviewing code for quality, or deciding how to structure functions, types, naming, and error handling. Reach for this on refactoring questions, "is this good code?", code smells, JSDoc and comment decisions, or test structure. (user)

availableCommands.name: frontend-patterns
availableCommands.description: Use when building or reviewing React and Next.js UI — components, custom hooks, state management, data fetching, forms and validation, error boundaries, animation, or accessibility. Also use when diagnosing re-render, bundle-size, or perceived-performance problems. (user)

availableCommands.name: handoff
availableCommands.description: Write or resume a cross-session handoff file. Use when the user asks to hand off, wrap up for a new session, save progress before a usage limit or context ceiling, or when starting work and .claude/handoff.md exists in the project ("pick up where we left off"). (user)

availableCommands.name: no-ai-slop
availableCommands.description: Edit drafts into sharper, more human writing while preserving the writer's personal voice, or detect AI-slop patterns without rewriting. Use when the user wants a draft clearer, more direct, more opinionated, or less AI-sounding, or asks whether writing reads as AI. (user)

availableCommands.name: ui-design
availableCommands.description: Visual design direction and UX quality rules for building or reviewing UI — websites, dashboards, landing pages, forms, navigation, charts, mobile screens. Use when choosing an aesthetic (palette, typography, layout, animation), when a design reads as generic or templated, or when checking UI against accessibility, touch, performance, and platform (HIG/Material) standards. (user)

availableCommands.name: plan
availableCommands.description: Restate requirements, assess risks, and create step-by-step implementation plan. WAIT for user CONFIRM before touching any code. (user)

availableCommands.name: refactor-clean
availableCommands.description: Find and safely remove dead code, unused exports, and unused dependencies, verifying with tests after each removal. Use for codebase cleanup and consolidation. (user)

availableCommands.name: update-docs
availableCommands.description: Regenerate CONTRIB and RUNBOOK docs from package.json and .env.example, and flag stale documentation. Use after a feature lands or when docs contradict the code. (user)

availableCommands.name: learn
availableCommands.description: Extract a reusable pattern from this session and save it as a properly-structured personal skill. Use after solving a non-trivial problem worth remembering. (user)

availableCommands.name: compact
availableCommands.description: Clear conversation history but keep a summary in context. Optional: /compact [instructions for summarization]

availableCommands.name: init
availableCommands.description: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation

availableCommands.name: pr-comments
availableCommands.description: Get comments from a GitHub pull request

availableCommands.name: security-review
availableCommands.description: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

availableCommands.name: insights
availableCommands.description: Generate a report analyzing your Claude Code sessions
